usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is effectively empty: the single claim has a blank statement backed only by one Wikipedia quote confirming family lineage. No other dossier claims exist, so the unjustified conclusions (acquisition authorship, rankings-as-authority, inherited role) cannot be matched to any cited dossier statement. A reader learns almost nothing about who Ana Botín is or what she has done, the dossier never states its own gaps, and there is nothing usable to prepare for a meeting with.
